purpose: Teach: たべ/横たわっ/のる/盗み/名乗り/注が/申し述べ/惜しみ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、給食、ちゃんとたべろよ
lines.en: Riku, eat your lunch properly, would you.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact older-sister tone. Quick, direct instruction without heat. Slight eye-roll underneath. The comfortable bossiness of someone who's told you this a hundred times.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、机に横たわって寝るなよ、桜
lines.en: You're the one lying across her desk napping, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, quick comeback. Light jab back — not defensive, just matching her energy. Slight smirk in the delivery. Eyes still half-closed from being woken up.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、新しい自転車にのる時にんな
lines.en: Riku, when you ride your new bike, you look different.
lines.style: Observation more than question. Curious, gentle. Not teasing — actually noticing something real about him. Slight wonder in the pause before 'different'.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、答案盗みするなよ、桜
lines.en: You're not going to cheat off the answer sheets, are you, Sakura.
lines.style: Steady warning. Not accusatory — just firm. The tone of someone who knows her well enough to say it plainly. Direct eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、フルネームで名乗りができるか?
lines.en: Riku, can you say your full name out loud?
lines.style: Genuine question underneath casual phrasing. Curious about who he is beyond the classroom version. Open, not challenging. Waiting for a real answer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、お茶を注がれる時、ちゃんとお辞儀しろよ、桜
lines.en: When someone pours you tea, bow properly, Sakura.
lines.style: Teaching moment, but warm. Not lecturing — guiding. Quiet conviction that this matters. The patience of someone who believes she can make you better.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、堂々と意見を申し述べろよ
lines.en: Riku, just say what you think. Don't hold back.
lines.style: Encouraging push. Firm but not harsh. Belief underneath — like she knows he has something worth saying and he needs permission to say it. Steady gaze.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、努力を惜しみなく続けてんな、桜
lines.en: You keep working hard without cutting corners, Sakura. I see that.
lines.style: Sincere acknowledgment. Warm and direct. No performance — just stating something true he's noticed. Small, genuine tone. Like he's telling her something that matters.
